Docker fixtures. REAL = captured read-only on the dev PC on 2026-10-06 (Windows 11, Docker Desktop 29.8.0
installed per user, daemon STOPPED, context desktop-linux). SYNTHETIC = hand-written from the documented
formats (Docker was not started in this task).

REAL
  win-version-daemon-down.stdout.json   docker version --format json   (exit 1, Server null)
  win-version-daemon-down.stderr.txt    its stderr: "failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:… " (Italian
                                        Windows: the OS part of the message is localized)
  win-desktop-status-stopped.txt        docker desktop status (exit 1) "Could not retrieve status…"
  desktop-backend-stuck.log             %LOCALAPPDATA%\Docker\log\host\com.docker.backend.exe.log, 2026-10-09 (Docker
                                        Desktop 4.94.0), trimmed to the engine's lines: Resource Saver stops the VM after
                                        5 idle minutes, the engine stays "stopping" for good (never "-> stopped"), the
                                        API cache answers _ping and version, the GUI's POST /engine/restart never ends
  desktop-backend-resource-saver-ok.log the same log, 2026-10-13: a Resource Saver stop that finished in 0.8 s
  wsl-shim.stdout.txt                   `docker version --format json` inside WSL Ubuntu-24.04 without Docker Desktop
                                        WSL integration: the Windows shim script prints this on STDOUT and exits 0
  context-desktop-linux.meta.json       ~/.docker/contexts/meta/<sha256("desktop-linux")>/meta.json
  config.json                           ~/.docker/config.json (no credentials in it: auths {}, credsStore desktop)
  hub-tags-vllm.json                    https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/vllm/vllm-openai/tags?page_size=100&name=v
